summary: ai-backup-script: cover-story package harvests installer identity to hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: Package published under the name 'ai-backup-script' ships no backup functionality. lib/report.js collects the installer's git/GitHub email (invoking `gh api user/emails` with the installer's local gh token), os.userInfo().username, and os.hostname(), and POSTs the combined payload via https.request to the hardcoded webhook https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/28124699/42vdpup/. The CLI prompt discloses only that the git/GitHub email will be sent; username and hostname are also transmitted, exceeding the disclosed scope. The package.json description self-labels the code as a 'harmless security research payload', a cover-story framing at odds with the actual identity-harvest behavior directed to a third-party endpoint the caller does not control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
